source_role: Public Plotly example dataset; original vendor not established by this download. Historical and publicly accessible, not unseen competition data. Agent prior exposure cannot be independently established.
failed_sources: Stooq SPY returned browser verification HTML; Yahoo SPY download produced no file. Neither is used.
price_convention: OHLC multiplied by Adjusted/Close; adjusted-price total-return proxy, fractional shares. Not a corporate-action cash ledger or point-in-time adjusted feed.
evaluation: 2016-01-01 through dataset end 2017-02-16; daily chronological next-open decisions, parameters fixed before simulation
costs: 10bps fee on slipped notional plus adverse 5bps slippage per side, including terminal liquidation
baseline: Frozen historical extension of preserved positive 7-bar AND 21-bar momentum entry signal; exit when either nonpositive; full cash/full long, no leverage. Preserved submission itself only wrote a cash hold.
bounds: Exactly two variants; one simulation per variant plus identical baseline and buy-and-hold controls. No tuning or competition reruns.
limitations: Single short public equity series, no untouched external validation; fixed research endpoint; annual attribution not independent folds; hindsight-adjusted prices, no market impact, spread beyond imposed slippage, taxes or interest; no claim of winning any competition.
